---
title: "Ideas So Big, they Fit on Post-It Notes"
date: "2008-04-21"
categories: ["Economics", "Politics"]
---

Big ideas from the [2020 Summit](http://www.smh.com.au/news/national/time-for-a-tax-revolution/2008/04/20/1208629731301.html?page=2 "2020 Summit"):

> Other “big ideas” on tax, captured on Post-it notes included:
>
> ? Reduce the number of taxes;\
> ? Eliminate payroll tax and stamp duty.

Like no one ever thought of that before!  There has never been a shortage of ideas in relation to tax reform – just a shortage of governments willing to implement them.

At least [Andrew Norton](http://andrewnorton.info/blog/2008/04/21/my-2020-weekend/ "Andrew Norton") dissented from the final standing ovation.
